title: Equilibrium domain geometry
action: Implement the equilibrium domain-structure model from Pertsev & Zembilgotov (1995). For S_r/S_r^0 = 0.5 the model gives d/D = 0.7 and D/H values as listed. Provide these geometry parameters to step2.
description: Required intermediate; outputs consumed by step2. Not directly scored.

title: Restoring-force constants
action: Implement R(x,y) and compute k_h_norm, k_sc_norm, k_sa_norm using the explicit formulas. Evaluate over d/D ∈ {0.3,0.5,0.7} and D/H ∈ {0.1,0.5,1,2,5,10}. Write force_constants.csv.
description: Normalized restoring-force constants for the collective vibration modes.
output_schema: Columns: mode (string, one of h, sc, sa), d_over_D (float), D_over_H (float), k_norm (float). The file must contain rows for all combinations of d_over_D and D_over_H listed above.

title: Dielectric contribution from soft c-mode
action: Use the equilibrium geometry model (step0) for S_r/S_r^0 = 0.5 to get d/D = 0.7 and D/H at H/H0 = 0.1,1,10,100. Compute k_sc_norm and Δε33_norm = (2√2)/(k_sc_norm * D/H). Write dielectric_contribution.csv.
description: Soft c-mode contribution to the permittivity as a function of normalized film thickness.
output_schema: Columns: H_norm (float, H/H0), delta_epsilon_norm (float). The file must contain one row for each H_norm value in {0.1, 1, 10, 100}.
